facts.text: The resort offers one- and two-bedroom Desert Pool Villas.
facts.excerpt: Experience a lavish retreat in nature with our one- and two-bedroom villas.

facts.text: Each Desert Pool Villa has a private pool, views of golden dunes and a dedicated Villa Host.
facts.excerpt: Each villa features a private pool, views of golden dunes, and the attentive care of a dedicated Villa Host.

facts.text: The One-Bedroom Villa is framed by dunes and desert palms and has a pool and terrace.
facts.excerpt: Experience a private sanctuary framed by sun-drenched dunes and lush desert palms, complete with a pool and terrace.

facts.text: The Two-Bedroom Villa suits families or groups of up to four adults.
facts.excerpt: our two-bedroom luxury villa is the perfect choice for families, or groups of up to four adults.

facts.text: Al Hadheerah is an open-air dinner spectacular serving Middle Eastern cuisine with live performances.
facts.excerpt: An open-air dinner spectacular that serves authentic Middle Eastern cuisine and enchanting live performances.

facts.text: Anwa is a rooftop lounge with sunsets, cocktails and Pan-Asian dishes.
facts.excerpt: Revel in breathtaking sunsets, masterfully crafted cocktails, and Pan-Asian delights at this rooftop lounge.

facts.text: Zala serves Mediterranean flavours at breakfast, lunch and dinner.
facts.excerpt: Breakfast, lunch or dinner, Zala is always brimming with the vibrant flavours of the Mediterranean.

facts.text: Guests can plan a private dinner with a bespoke menu in a desert setting.
facts.excerpt: Plan a private dinner with a bespoke menu and an idyllic desert setting.

facts.text: The spa offers speciality facials, massages and traditional hammam experiences.
facts.excerpt: Decompress from the outside-in with our speciality facials, massages and traditional hammam experiences.

facts.text: A sound bath experience takes place in the spa's outdoor desert area.
facts.excerpt: This unique wellness experience combines the soothing effects of a sound bath with a feeling of weightlessness, taking place at the spa outdoor desert area

facts.text: The resort offers yoga under the evening stars.
facts.excerpt: Refine your yoga flow and practice mindfulness as you stretch towards the sky under sparkle of the evening stars.

facts.text: The gym has modern equipment and personal training sessions can be booked.
facts.excerpt: Our gym provides guests with state-of-the-art equipment and the option to book personal training sessions.

facts.text: Camelback trekking is offered and is accessible for all ages.
facts.excerpt: This storybook experience is accessible for all ages and a wonderful way to make lasting family memories.

facts.text: Guided 4x4 desert drives cross the Al Marmoom Desert Conservation Reserve, where guests might spot the Arabian oryx.
facts.excerpt: Experience an Arabian desert safari through the mesmerising Al Marmoom Desert Conservation Reserve, where you might just spot the majestic Arabian oryx.

facts.text: Private hot-air balloon rides take in the Margam desert from above.
facts.excerpt: Take in the stunning scenery of the Margam desert and surrounding communities from high above as you glide effortlessly through the air on a private hot-air balloon ride.

facts.text: Bab Al Shams is a low-slung desert resort modeled after an Arabian fort.
facts.excerpt: a low-slung desert resort modeled after an Arabian fort

facts.text: The reimagined Bab Al Shams is the first property in Kerzner's Rare Finds portfolio of destination-focused hotels.
facts.excerpt: The reimagined Bab Al Shams is the first property in the Rare Finds portfolio of destination-focused hotels from Kerzner

facts.text: Bab Al Shams first opened in 2004.

facts.text: Three large swimming pools look out over the desert.
facts.excerpt: Three large swimming pools look out over the desert, flanked by new restaurants and rooftop lounges.
